references.Direct Staff: IS-Total D232:D258, including wages and temporary staff
references.Installation costs: IS-Total D179:D181: external contractors 2142 and internal labour 2143
references.Recovery: Group C45:C48; percentage of Revenue divided by matching cost

constraints: No example branch, amount, rate, reporting date, budget or previous-year comparison enters GC500.
Unmapped Revenue or Direct costs retain a separate allocation-pending row; they are never silently dropped.
Unknown rates remain unpriced and priced totals remain partial.
Onsite complete charges and whole-job recorded Revenue are different scopes.
Gross Margin uses the existing Revenue-less-direct-costs model and is labelled known costs.
Difference so far uses the existing reconciled branch total including overheads and priced wages.
No unsupported final EBITDA, EBIT or depreciation amount is created.
Accommodation and meals remain separate from labour; the confirmed salary allowance remains in priced wages.
Whole-job additional forecast is job forecast minus current record. The onsite equipment subtotal is not an additional amount to add to the whole-job forecast.
